title: Library search tests with hand-derived expectations for the untested query kinds, mql cases and extract windows
body: Batch 3 of sufr-25f57e. In libsufr/src/search.rs, on a small multi-sequence text whose expectations are derived by hand: count, locate and extract across the six (text, suffixes) modes and -m, count with -m; queries not found before $, empty, containing N, containing $, longer than the text, equal to a whole sequence, at the text end; mql shorter than, equal to and longer than the query on a plain and a masked file; extract with before larger than the distance to the sequence start, after past the sequence end, after Some(0), on the second sequence; locate order with sequence names 10 and 2; a search on the u64 build. The decisions on sufr-2fd179 and on a query holding $ are on the parent.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/1ddc0e5b
notes.text: Decided 2026-11-03: the empty query stays as it is, every suffix matches, and batch 3 pins it. Sequence order in locate becomes file order, sufr-bd7605, fixed before this batch.
